milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate to the honeycomb_block 2x2 landmark (centered at spawn-relative coords 10.5, 0.5, 8) and face it, confirming they have visually located it. Max distance 16 blocks with 60° facing tolerance models 'player can see the target'.

Uses inventory_has because the meaningful outcome of interacting with the furnace is obtaining glass (smelted from sand). The player starts with sand and coal but no glass, so glass appearing in inventory confirms successful furnace interaction. This is more reliable than detecting GUI opens.

Uses inventory_has because crafting white_stained_glass places the item directly into the player's inventory. The player starts without any white_stained_glass, so its presence confirms successful crafting at the crafting table using glass + white_dye.
